description_en: Call this operation to submit a job to asynchronously extract a digital watermark. The watermark can be a copyright watermark or a tracing watermark
description_zh: 通过调用本接口提交数字水印（版权水印或溯源水印）提取作业，开始异步提取版权水印或溯源水印
name: SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the video from which you want to extract the watermark. You can specify only one video ID. You can obtain the video ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the navigation pane, choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- Call the [SearchMedia](~~436559~~) operation. The video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
parameters.description_zh:
待提取水印的视频的视频ID，仅支持传入单个视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 登录[视频点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[SearchMedia](~~436559~~)接口请求后会返回视频ID（VideoId）。

parameters.description_en:
The type of the watermark that you want to extract. Valid values:

- **TraceMark**: tracing watermark.
- **CopyrightMark**: copyright watermark.
parameters.description_zh:
水印提取类型。取值：

- **TraceMark**：溯源水印。
- **CopyrightMark**：版权水印。
